source: SSC GD Constable examination notice (ssc.gov.in) and past paper pattern
intro: The CBT has four sections of equal weight: reasoning, general knowledge, elementary mathematics and English or Hindi. The physical test follows the CBT and has its own standards.
note: The topic lists follow the broad areas SSC publishes in its notice. SSC does not give a chapter-wise list, so use these as a checklist and treat the questions asked in the past papers as the guide to depth.

sections.name: General Intelligence and Reasoning
topics: Analogies, classification, similarities and differences
Number, letter and figure series
Coding and decoding, relationships, blood relations, direction sense
Venn diagrams, arithmetical reasoning, problem solving
Non-verbal reasoning: figure counting, paper folding, pattern completion

sections.name: General Knowledge and General Awareness
topics: Current events of national and international importance
India and its neighbours: history, culture, geography, economic scene, polity
Sports, awards, books and authors, important days
General science as seen in everyday life and research
Static GK: first in India, organisations, schemes, national parks and similar fact tables

sections.name: Elementary Mathematics
topics: Number system, fractions and decimals, square roots
Percentage, ratio and proportion, averages
Interest, profit and loss, discount
Time and work, time and distance
Mensuration of basic figures, simple algebra and geometry
Data tables and simple graphs

sections.name: English or Hindi
topics: Error spotting and fill in the blanks
Synonyms and antonyms, idioms, one-word substitution
Comprehension of a short passage
Sentence arrangement and basic grammar
sections.tip: You pick English or Hindi at the time of application, so check the language choice in your form.

sections.name: Physical tests (PET and PST)
topics: Race, height, chest and other standards are set by the notice for each force and for men and women separately. These are qualifying and are not part of the CBT syllabus.
